tags.json.note: omits one license, whose SPDX identifier the repository typos check reads as a misspelling of Matrix

news.json.note: latest 12 entries, normalized as app-lib api/minecraft_news.rs; images localized under assets/news

discover/*.json.note: the first 40 mods and modpacks and the first 20 of the other types; the icons in assets/projects come from each hit's icon_url, converted to WebP; omits four modpacks (COBBLEVERSE, BattleArmory TACZ, SkyBlock Enhanced, FPS Modpack) whose pages name the official Modrinth launcher, which the repository brand guard (scripts/axolotl/brand-guard.mjs) rejects

projects/*.json.note: keeps the newest 8 versions, cuts changelogs at 2000 characters and drops embedded dependencies; description images, gallery images and member avatars keep their original URLs and are not bundled

content-names.json.note: MC 百科 entries for the recorded slugs: [wiki ID, Chinese name]

sources: modrinth.index.json of each pinned modpack version (data/modpacks.json)
instance-content.json.note: one row per installed file; custom-fabric is the plain Fabric 26.3 instance; the icons of these projects are bundled in assets/projects

sources: icon_url of each referenced Modrinth project
t1tOiUHZ.note: client JAR and ZIP files only; project icons fetched from the Modrinth API and bundled under assets/projects

default-skins.json.note: textures decoded from the data URLs into assets/skins, numbered in that order

sources: each file's source: the server jar, Java and command it ran, and when
servers/*.json.note: console output of a first start, the listed commands and a stop, with the folder the run left behind; lines replay with their original timing

screenshots.json.note: gallery images of Fabulously Optimized, Cobblemon, Iris and Sodium, resized to WebP in assets/screenshots and shown as the instances' screenshots; each entry keeps its source_url

account.json.note: public profile, skin and cape only; no sign-in credentials

remote-servers.json.note: MOTDs, player counts and icons recorded from each server; demo status is a snapshot
